title: Oki Shannon on building an anti-gravity device using Ferris Williams' theory

tellings.quote: Shannon is on record saying, "If we were to build an anti-gravitational device, it would be built on the principles involved in William's theory."

plain: A man named Oke Shannon, whom Michels ties to Los Alamos National Laboratory, the US government's weapons research lab in New Mexico, is said to have backed a theory by a man named Ferris Williams as the way to beat gravity. Michels quotes him in an episode on early secret work on flying craft: "If we were to build an anti-gravitational device, it would be built on the principles involved in William's theory." He offers it as a sign that serious lab scientists took the idea of a machine that cancels gravity seriously.
